articles.title: The touchscreen MacBook Pro is just a MacBook Pro with a touchscreen
articles.description: Apple's long-awaited touchscreen MacBook Pro is finally here. I got to try this MacBook that, according to the last two Apple CEOs, shouldn't exist. articles.title: Binance hackers stole $6.3 billion in record-breaking crypto heist

articles.title: Maine’s data center revolt will decide who controls the Senate
articles.description: Maine Sen. Susan Collins, a Republican, was midway through defending her record during the final debate of the midterms when an audience member cut her short. "I'm terrified," a man shouted. "AI data centers are destroying our climate. They are poisoning our water." Collins brushed off the outburst, tying the man to her Democratic challenger, […]

articles.title: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
articles.description: The Wikimedia Foundation is staking out a middle ground in a group of landmark AI copyright cases, pushing courts to legally protect large language models (LLMs) training on copyrighted work - but not chatbots regurgitating that work to users.
